text:
rafa (Hiring Manager): Quick ask 1: new hire Liam starts Monday AM. Can someone drop a tiny first-week agenda + a 30/60/90 bullet list I can paste into the welcome email? Need clear "what to expect" items and who to ping for access.
mike (IT): I4bb happy to. Will we ship laptop or will Liam pick up at office? Do we need special VPN or service accounts?
rafa (Hiring Manager): Ship to SF office desk. No special GPU or acl access initially, just standard dev groups + read-only infra. Add docs-edit and eng-starters groups.
zoe (People Ops): I342 on it. I4dd I4cc will keep this short so you can paste. Also will set a 30-min "first-week expectations" slot for Fri.
tess (Security): Quick safety note: 2FA mandatory, security intro before any infra creds, and blocker if onboarding forms not complete. I can run a 15-min security intro Tue.
onboard-bot: Reminder: new-hire packet assigned to liam.k. Tasks: I-9, tax form, SSO invite. Due: 2026-04-01 17:00 PT.
zoe (People Ops): Compact first-week agenda (copyable):
- Day 0 (prestart): confirm device delivery, complete HR forms, Slack + SSO invite, add to groups (eng-starters, docs-edit, infra-read).
- Day 1: 9:30 People Ops welcome (benefits, payroll), 11:00 manager 1:1, 2:00 buddy intro, 4:00 team standup + quick goals.
- Day 2: 10:00 product orientation, 1:00 infra-read walkthrough (no creds yet), 3:30 small starter task assigned.
- Day 3: pair review PR, docs editing session, security intro (15m).
- Day 4-5: focus on starter task, meet cross-functional partners, EOW check-in + 30-min feedback sync.
- EOW deliverable: open PR with small fix and short note "top 3 learnings".
zoe (People Ops): Short 30/60/90 for a manager note (3 bullets each):
- 30d: complete security + codebase orientation, ship initial small PR, attend weekly product sync.
- 60d: own a minor ticket from triage to merge, present progress in team demo, handle routine deployment checklist.
- 90d: lead delivery of a small feature, reduce review cycles for own PRs, propose one improvement impacting customers.
rafa (Hiring Manager): Perfect. Can you also add a short "who to ping" list? I'm thinking IT for device, Security for creds, Buddy for questions, People Ops for payroll/benefits.
mike (IT): Will do. I5b1 device queue created, imaging Mon 07:30 PT. CLI snippet if you want to reprovision quickly:
```
redwood-provision --user liam.k --groups eng-starters,docs-edit,infra-read --device mac-air
```
tess (Security): I'll create a short checklist to share in the first-day message: enable 2FA, register YubiKey option, read security intro doc <https://security.redwood/onboarding>.
zoe (People Ops): I'll slot Fri 4pm for the manager expectations check and DM rafa the calendar invite. Also attaching the tiny manager primer (how to run 1:1s first 30 days).
onboard-bot: Device shipment scheduled. Tracking: SF-DEL-4421. ETA: Mon 09:00 PT.
rafa (Hiring Manager): Thanks everyone. I'll paste this into the welcome note. If you need Liam's personal email for shipping DM me. :thumbsup:
